name: error_rate_24h
description: Count of tool.success=false events over total, by tool.name, last 24 hours
aql: ['mcp-events'] | where ['span.name'] startswith 'tool.' | where _time > ago(24h) | summarize errors=countif(['tool.success']==false), total=count() by tool.name | extend rate = errors * 1.0 / total | last 24 hours
